research.title: AHBG — Agent Harness Benchmark Game
research.purpose: A persistent game world for agents to perceive, plan, communicate, move and build.
research.relations: UCNS supplies board geometry; AHBG supplies game rules and agent interaction.
research.hmmm: The current target is one functional persistent plane; wider multiplayer and federation remain deferred.

research.title: English Gonol Construction
research.purpose: Builds English character, word and definition constructions while preserving identity, order and source positions.
research.relations: METAPAT supplies affixiation semantics, UCNS supplies geometry, and EDCM may evaluate the outputs.
research.hmmm: Full-corpus evidence does not establish downstream inference quality or independent graduation.

research.title: Python Gonol Construction
research.purpose: Constructs Python source from glyphs and control characters while retaining every source occurrence.
research.relations: Consumes UCNS Public Gonol geometry and the construction method used by English Gonol.
research.hmmm: Parser tokens and syntax trees are witnesses; independent release authority remains unresolved.

research.title: ZFAE construction research
research.purpose: Investigates how admitted input and retained state produce an attributable inference.
research.relations: ZFAE owns the conceptual specification, PTCNA owns neural construction, and a0 owns runtime integration.
research.hmmm: Neural-audit prerequisites and UCHC release/reconsumption remain incomplete in this source snapshot.

research.title: EPAC-derived carrier audit
research.purpose: Tests whether coordinates derived from EPAC preserve the frozen carrier controls.
research.relations: Consumes exact EPAC source; EPAC keeps its implementation and public-contract authority.
research.hmmm: Bond-context orbital participation, ligand-field regime, coordination capacity and topology remain unresolved.

research.title: Psychosocial Fauna Research
research.purpose: Studies transmissible thought-pattern lineages, identity coupling, susceptibility, accountability and repair.
research.relations: Keeps pattern-lineage ecology and agency-displacement phenomenology as separate research tracks.
research.hmmm: The simulator does not establish external-agent ontology; this is not a clinical or diagnostic instrument.

research.title: From Photons to the Macroverse
research.purpose: Preserves and audits a consciousness-first candidate theory and its proposed synthetic tests.
research.relations: Retains source claims, audit findings and exact work-graph identities without transferring authority from adjacent projects.
research.hmmm: Candidate-program survival adds no empirical validation of the metaphysical postulate or consciousness claims.

research.title: URPCS codec experiment
research.purpose: Explores a recursive pairing and witness format with reference vectors and an independent decoder.
research.relations: A codec-local Gonol is separate from UCNS geometry; PCEA is a separate project.
research.hmmm: Round-trip and decoder evidence establish neither confidentiality nor production security.
